data.title: SK Hynix shares soar over 8% as profit beats, chipmaker to return $25 billion to investors
data.description: Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix soared over 8% on Wednesday as third-quarter profit sharply beats estimates.
data.author: Jenny Lee
